## Assignment of a design licence

**Assignor:** ⟦PERSON|Alwen di Sarn⟧

**Assignee:** ⟦ORG|Pale Comet Design Ltd⟧

**Independent witness:** ⟦PERSON|Joël de la Vey⟧

The Assignor transfers the right to reproduce the decorative panel described in the sealed annex. The licence is exclusive for exhibition catalogues and nonexclusive for workshop teaching materials. It does not cover the underlying construction drawings, which remain available to the Assignor for later commissions.

The transfer price is GBP 2,600. Half is payable on signing and the balance after delivery of the print files. The Assignee must provide a proof for approval before any commercial print run. Silence for seven days permits production of that proof only and does not approve a revised design.

Payment instructions: bank account ⟦BANK|GB64 VELT 2045 6182 7704 3?⟧; tax reference ⟦TAX|73-84O19?2⟧. Both values contain unresolved transcription damage. The Assignee must obtain confirmation through the agreed contact channel before making payment.

The witness records that the Assignor signed voluntarily and retained an identical copy. No person is authorised to vary the permitted uses by telephone. A signed amendment must identify the additional medium and the applicable royalty.

Executed on 4 November 2026 in York.

Assignor: ⟦PERSON|Alwen di Sarn⟧. Witness: ⟦PERSON|Joël de la Vey⟧.
